title: docs(concepts): Word support extension for Outlook add-in
body:
## Summary

- Adds concept document describing how to extend the `ihub-outlook-addin` to also run in Microsoft Word
- Uses a Host Context Provider pattern — per-host strategy objects (Outlook/Word) selected at runtime via `Office.context.host`
- ~60-70% of the existing codebase (auth, API services, UI) reused as-is; only ~10 files need changes
- Single webpack build, separate XML manifests per host

## Test plan

- [ ] Concept document is readable and accurately describes the architecture
- [ ] No code changes in this PR
